$comment: HAND-AUTHORED from v0125-lid-retained.xml, transcribed element by element from the XML bytes - NOT produced by e142DocumentToJson (Rule 10, D-030). Covers LID on both element types that carry one and are modelled: BinCodeType and DeviceIdType. Clause 13.3 addresses a position by 'either the X and Y coordinate, or the location identifier, or both', so all three forms appear: X/Y only, X/Y AND LID (the coordinate places it, the LID names it), and LID only. The lattice here is FULL (2x2, four X/Y entries), so the fifth entry has nowhere to go and is excluded with E142_XML_LID_ONLY_EXCLUDED - the branch v0125-coordinate-lid-mixed does NOT reach, because that one has free cells. LIDs are deliberately awkward - mixed case, a separator, one that looks numeric - and are xs:string with no facet, so none may be normalised.
